headline: SEA @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.19 at CLE 3.76, with a projected total of 7.95. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SEA: SEA moved +0.13 runs while CLE moved -0.10, changing the projected margin by +0.23 runs. NRFI probability rose +7.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Logan Gilbert has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Naylor, Julio Rodríguez, Cole Young, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags David Fry, Daniel Schneemann because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
